note: Maps publicly owned utility net-metered capacity to incorporated cities. A utility merges only when its service territory lies inside the city, so all of its capacity does too. Covering a city is not sufficient: Imperial Irrigation District covers all of El Centro, but El Centro is 0.2% of IID.

inverterLoadingRatio.note: Converts AC-reported capacity to DC. The band spans fleet vintage: 1.08 is the 2018 median for string-inverter systems and 1.25 the upper 2024 all-sector median. Cumulative POU fleets contain both.
